newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil October FDI at $935 million.
newsitem.headline: Brazil October FDI at $935 million.

text.p: Foreign direct investment (FDI) into Brazil in October totalled $935 million, a Central Bank spokesman said.
The spokesman, confirming a report in the Gazeta Mercantil newspaper, said net direct investment was $785 million after repatriations of $150 million last month.
FDI in the January-September period totaled $5.804 billion after $347 million inflows in September.
The Central Bank spokesman said official current account, foreign reserve and FDI figures for October will be announced between Nov 15 and 18.
